description: This file defines a React component 'CloudZeroIntegrationSettings' that renders UI for managing CloudZero integration settings, including viewing configuration details, triggering dry runs, exporting data, editing, and deleting the integration. It utilizes hooks, external components, and Ant Design UI elements.

methods.name: handleDryRun
methods.description: Triggers a dry run operation using the useCloudZeroDryRun hook and displays success or error messages based on the outcome.

methods.name: handleExport
methods.description: Initiates data export to CloudZero using the useCloudZeroExport hook and shows feedback messages.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Opens the modal for editing CloudZero settings.

methods.name: handleEditModalOk
methods.description: Handles confirmation of edit modal, updates parent state.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Executes deletion of the CloudZero integration, provides feedback, and updates parent state.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal without action.
